disagreements:
AUTHOR EVIDENCE STATUS — 2026-11-04 — NOT READY FOR ACCURACY APPROVAL. User requested a finished guide; three end-route files totaling 124 Japanese action steps and guide.json are committed, all reviewed:false. The choices match directly inspected Set A but the exact-target two-independent-Japanese-set gate has not been established. No title-specific owner-approved source exception or independent review approval is recorded. The 2026-11-04 author evidence-attribution correction below does NOT close exact 2015 target-parity or choice-level END1/END2 blockers.

TARGET AND SOURCE COMPATIBILITY
- Exact target is 2015-11-27 Liar-soft Selection 01 (LIRS-001) Windows DVD; target URL is a release-specific Japanese retailer and its edition-specific cover is verified. The developer calls Selection a new-package release of old games, but says nothing conclusive about identical script/ending/save flags.
- Publisher's official download-edition page (https://liar.co.jp/directdl.html) explicitly distinguishes original package 640×480/high-color from the 2007+ downloadable 800×600/full-color build. Japanese 2017/10/31 forum respondents specifically confirm Selection 01 displays at 800×600 like the DL edition (https://phoebe.bbspink.com/test/read.cgi/hgame/1501949720/, posts 233–235). This is useful target-era technical evidence but NOT proof that Selection's script, final choice availability, save flags or CG behavior matches patched 2002 Set A.
- Source A, https://sagaoz.net/foolmaker/game/k/euthanasia.html, is a full Japanese 100%-CG guide tested on 「不明（修正後）」 (patched older PC game), not the 2015 DVD. Author checked all ordered literal actions: TRUE 35/35, END1 44/44, END2 45/45. Save slots 1–3, loadbacks, internal 本編からはじめる continuations, post-ending no-choice CG recovery, and 既視感→記憶を失う resets match Set A; exact display text in the two corrupted 「青磁との�Jを感じた」 occurrences is normalized in simpleJp to 「青磁との絆を感じた」 from a derivative archive that CANNOT count as independent Set B.
- Source B, https://www5a.biglobe.ne.jp/~rarin/ra/euthanasia.html, independently supports TRUE and prints the same final literal 「……終わりじゃない。」, but has several alternate earlier choices and reverses the relative order of two identical optional selections. Both finish TRUE; do not assert choice-by-choice equivalence or identical CG states for the selected DVD.

MAIN ENDING STRUCTURE — WHAT B DOES SUPPORT
- 2025 original Japanese firsthand article https://note.com/clever_swan1954/n/nf8b3a67e7520 explicitly states 「このゲームは一本道であり」 and identifies three final decisions semantically: 『共に在り続ける』 (A's END1), 『在ることを終える』 (A's END2), and 『二人で全てを忘れて生きていく』 (A's TRUE). They are the author's descriptive paraphrases, NOT the game's literal final menu strings.
- 2026 Japanese firsthand DMM-download account https://cuguf54uity.blog.jp/archives/29915477.html describes the predetermined order of four-day loops, no heroine-route endings, and exactly three main story endings. Together with the Rarin alternate TRUE choice path, these are substantial evidence that earlier choices are often SCENE/CG selectors rather than main-ending defining steps. A 2022 DLsite edition firsthand Japanese report independently documents same-story 本編からはじめる continuation, replay/reset for missed scenes, second-playthrough 盲点 use, and post-TRUE 狐の嫁入り. It uses 'character endings' informally for intermediate arcs and does not establish new main staff-roll endings. They do not prove that all early choices are entirely irrelevant to game state, or independently verify the exact 2015 DVD's complete END1/END2 Japanese literal choices.
- Author did NOT copy Set A text into Set B. Current route jpGuide2 has 13 directly supported TRUE literals. END1/END2 final terminal options are ONLY literal in Set A; their jpGuide2 fields now use the exact omission placeholder. The independent 2025 B source's descriptions of each outcome remain in enGuide/research for context, NOT as literal menu evidence. End1/END2 memory-reset steps now quote the independent Japanese netlaputa menu explanation; this supports reset mechanics on an earlier release, NOT 2015 disc parity. These semantic terminal quotes must not be misrepresented as literal in-game labels. The earliest independent two Japanese sets never print a second full END1/END2 choice list, and neither target-era Japanese account provides a DVD-specific one. The independent accuracy review has CHANGES REQUESTED for this and exact-target applicability.

TRUE CHOICE ORDER / REPLAY
- Source A orders TRUE→END1→END2 and demonstrates this order on its patched build. A separate 2018 Japanese firsthand account https://pukkura.hatenablog.com/entry/2018/01/04/192008 reports the THIRD final option appearing after two other endings plus a memory reset. That is a different experienced order, not proof of a hard universal prerequisite. The TRUE route's player-facing note instructs a safe reset/replay if TRUE is absent. Do not invent a save at the end, a cross-reset load, or a claimed mandatory previous ending.
- 既視感→記憶を失う is a destructive NEW full run, distinct from normal 本編からはじめる between consecutive four-day loops. The original publisher patch note https://www.liar.co.jp/kusari.html confirms gallery data retained on memory reset after patch; exact Selection parity still unverified.

100% CG / BONUS
- Independent Japanese advice https://honjo-zo.hatenablog.com/entry/20030401/1049122800 states 盲点 must be ON for CG completion. First-4-day-loop toggle availability and later replay guidance are from indexed-only or redirect-looped Japanese blogs; these are NOT directly inspected B and are NOT asserted as universal 2015 timing. Guide says check the toggle at first reachable title-menu return and turn ON when offered; if left OFF, additional full replay(s) may be necessary. A says five 狐の嫁入り bonus episodes appear after TRUE (perhaps all endings) and persist through reset. The route mentions them without a made-up compulsory prerequisite.
- No directly inspected primary source documents a fourth bad-end detour. Saves 1–3 are SCENE/CG excursions, NOT badEndPath branches. Do not invent extra ending labels.

SOURCE INDEPENDENCE / LIMITATIONS
- lastcharles reproduces Set A; AON_KABOCYA cites Set A. Neither qualifies as independent Set B. Chinese walkthroughs/translations do not qualify. Five indexed-only/redirect-looped Japanese blogs are retained as provenance-only with NO B tag. Their excerpts do not clear source gates. Other directly read independent Japanese reviews remain B only for facts explicitly stated in their source notes.
- The full 124-step source-A fidelity check and JSON/CI checks are not independent route accuracy or structural reviews. Current repository policy keeps reviewer roles separate from the author. The author does not set reviewed:true or self-approve.

REMAINING GATE FOR AN ACCURACY PASS
1. Independently verify that the selected 2015 Selection 01 DVD preserves exact main ending options, any prerequisites and save/CG flags, compared with Set A's older patched Windows build (exact-target written Japanese play report or a genuine same-script comparison).
2. Establish independent Japanese coverage for END1/END2's main-route-defining decisions, or obtain an accuracy reviewer’s source-supported determination that earlier intermediate choices are non-defining while final outcome choices are independently corroborated. Do NOT treat derivative copies or other editions as exact-target proof.
3. Have a distinct structural reviewer and accuracy reviewer evaluate the FINAL route blobs and record source-bounded outcomes; only an independent authorized review orchestrator may mark reviewed:true. Keep PR draft/ unmerged while these material facts remain unresolved.

This supports the END2 outcome name fragment only; it is NOT the exact full menu choice, nor source evidence for the 2015 DVD. Keep END2 jpGuide2 as the canonical omission placeholder. The TRUE terminal now supplies the two complete source-A alternative choice labels conditionally (END1/END2 ONLY when actually visible), tells a reader to finish an alternative outcome, enter 既視感→記憶を失う, play the END1 and END2 route sections for documented scene saves, then attempt TRUE again after another full reset. This makes the previously vague fallback executable when the documented alternative choices appear but does NOT verify that the Selected DVD exposes them or that clearing two endings always unlocks TRUE. The END1 opening and END2 terminal have updated continuity notes for this contingency. No literal simpleJp choice text, ordering, saves or loads changed. Exact-target 2015 script/flag proof (A1), deterministic TRUE unlock/reachability (A2), independent exact END1 literal choice and 2015 reachability (A3), and independent full END2 choice/reachability (A4) remain OPEN.
